description.en: Full-stack Next.js dashboard with account authentication, a Prisma-backed database, and Gemini-generated summaries. Tracks schedule, sleep, habits, gym progress, and finances, and syncs with Google Calendar. Installable as a PWA. Built solo.

Interactive capture station built for a U-Tech event. A procedural 3D rotary telephone sits over a full-bleed wordmark; picking up the handset plays a recorded message, then the page turns into a live camera and microphone booth with a waveform visualiser that writes each take straight to disk.

Cross-platform learning app for students, teachers, and admins at SMA Regina Pacis Surakarta, covering exams, materials, quizzes, and grades behind role-based access. React Native and Expo on Firebase. Built solo, demoed to a teacher and a small group of students.
Community site for U-Tech, the technology community for SMP and SMA Regina Pacis students exploring modern tech. React with client-side routing, built solo.
Dijkstra implementation in C++ that finds the least congested route across a simulated 2D traffic grid, weighting each cell by traffic density rather than raw distance.
Branching narrative that hands the reader one small act of kindness, giving up a seat to an elderly stranger, then follows where each choice leads. React and Framer Motion, built in two days.

Selenium and BeautifulSoup scraper that walks Tokopedia search results across multiple pages, pulling name, price, image, link, and units sold from each listing and writing the set to a spreadsheet with pandas.

title: Push Up and Pull Up Challenge App

description.en: Year-long challenge tracker: one push-up for every day of the year, one pull-up for every week of it. React and Tailwind.
Console finance tracker in Python. Appends dated income and expense entries with their reasons to a local file and carries a running balance across sessions, with input validation on every field.
